title: Yummy Garlicky Australian Beef Skillet
description: A kid-friendly Australian dish featuring tender beef, onion, and garlic, cooked to perfection in a cast-iron skillet.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the beef strips and cook until they are browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the beef broth, tomato paste, salt, and pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until the sauce has thickened and the beef is cooked through.
Reduce the heat to low and let the skillet simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Serve the beef and sauce hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
